tasks.label: Dev: Ocean
tasks.command: for p in $(pgrep -f "electron-vite dev --config games/to-the-ocean/electron.vite.config.ts"); do [ "$p" = "$$" ] && continue; pgid=$(awk '/^(NSpgid|PGid):/{print $2}' /proc/$p/status 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$pgid" ] && kill -TERM -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 0.5; npx electron-vite dev --config games/to-the-ocean/electron.vite.config.ts

tasks.label: Build: Game
tasks.detail: Pick a game + target platform(s), then build + package with electron-builder
tasks.command: set -e; G="${input:game}"; echo "[Build] Building $G with Vite..."; npx electron-vite build --config "games/$G/electron.vite.config.ts"; WIN=""; LINUX=""; MAC=""; for pt in ${input:platforms}; do p="${pt%%:*}"; t="${pt#*:}"; case "$p" in win) WIN="$WIN $t";; linux) LINUX="$LINUX $t";; mac) MAC="$MAC $t";; esac; done; EB_ARGS=""; [ -n "$WIN" ] && EB_ARGS="$EB_ARGS --win$WIN"; [ -n "$LINUX" ] && EB_ARGS="$EB_ARGS --linux$LINUX"; [ -n "$MAC" ] && EB_ARGS="$EB_ARGS --mac$MAC"; echo "[Build] Packaging with electron-builder ($EB_ARGS)..."; npx electron-builder $EB_ARGS; echo '[Build] Done. Opening release folder...'; OPENER=xdg-open; command -v xdg-open >/dev/null 2>&1 || OPENER=open; $OPENER "${workspaceFolder}/release"

args.command: printf '%s\n' 'win:portable|Windows Portable|Single .exe, no install needed' 'win:nsis|Windows Installer|NSIS .exe installer' 'mac:dmg|macOS DMG|Disk image installer' 'mac:zip|macOS Zip|Zipped app bundle' 'linux:AppImage|Linux AppImage|Portable single-file executable' 'linux:deb|Linux .deb|Debian/Ubuntu package' 'linux:rpm|Linux .rpm|Fedora/RHEL package' 'linux:flatpak|Linux Flatpak|Sandboxed Flathub package'
args.description: Select target format(s) — pick multiple to build several at once
